scoring: AUC / Mann-Whitney rank skill (0.5 = no skill); no-leakage, coverage as-of year t-1
target: UTLA had >=10 confirmed measles cases (a cluster) in the year
verdict: Pooled cluster AUC: coverage-alone 0.791; model surface 0.799 (spatial pooling, +0.008, within noise); cohort accumulation 0.794 (helps 2024, hurts 2025 — no robust gain); deprivation 0.545 (near chance — measles under-vaccination is community-specific, not deprivation-driven). Honest conclusion: with the available open data, COVERAGE IS A NEAR-SUFFICIENT SPATIAL STATISTIC — no tested addition robustly beats it. Only 2 target years; the teen/young-adult susceptible cohorts (pre-2014 UTLA coverage) are the missing information we cannot obtain at this resolution.
